title: Encrypted Chat
description: Deep dive into end-to-end encrypted messaging with Nostr NIP-44

steps.title: NIP-44 Encryption
steps.description: Notention uses Nostr NIP-44 for end-to-end encryption. Messages are encrypted with a shared secret derived from both parties' keys.

steps.title: Forward Secrecy
steps.description: Each conversation uses ephemeral keys. Compromising long-term keys doesn't decrypt past messages.

steps.title: Start Encrypted Chat
steps.description: Open Chat view, click New Chat, enter recipient's npub

steps.title: Verification
steps.description: Compare safety numbers (emoji fingerprints) with your contact to verify no MITM attack

steps.title: Verify Safety Number
steps.description: Click the shield icon in chat header, compare emojis with contact

steps.title: Group Chats
steps.description: NIP-44 supports group encryption. Create a group, invite members via npub, all messages encrypted to all members.
